generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

1.Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by any State Government / Government of India /Union Territory.2)It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.3) The bidder is required to ensure browser compatibility of the computer well in advance to the last date and time for receipt of tenders. The departments shall not be responsible for non-accessibility of e-Procurement portal due to internet connectivity issues and technical glitches at bidders end.4) EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.5) Bidder shall pay Contract Management Module processing fees of 0.025perct of the contact value (Min Rs.500/- & Max Rs.7500/-) soon after contract has been issued to bidder.6) The Successful bidder must submit 5percet Security Deposit to the amount put to Tender at the Time of Agreement in the Form of DD/FD/NSC/Renewable bank guarantee.
8)Contractors should be registered with KPWD Class III and above

9)Conditional tenders will not be accepted. 10) The tenderer shall bear all costs associated with the preparation and submission of his tender, and the employer will in no case be responsible and liable for those costs. 11) The cost of the Tender Processing shall not be refundable.12)Royalty on construction materials and other taxes will be deducted as per prevailing Govt orders. 13) As per Karnataka state Government order LD/300/LET/2006 Bangalore dated 01.01.2007 and Government letter no PW/134/BMS/2007 dated 27.07.2007, a sum amounting to 1% of the bill amount will be deducted towards constructions labour welfare fund.14)The employer reserves the rights to Reject or accept any or all the tenders without assigning any reasons.
15)Other conditions are as per KW Standard Tender Document.

16)The Work should be completed in stipulated period.17) Department will not supply any materials0riginal documents / Certificates shall be produced at the time of opening of Technical bid. 18) All the formats prescribe in the bid document shall be filled by the Tenderer in complete manner otherwise it will be rejected.19) In case if the death of a contractor, after executing the agreement / commencement of the work, his legal heir, is an eligible registered contractor and is willing, can execute and complete the work, at the accepted tender rates, irrespective of the cost of the work.20) The contractors assessed tender capacity will be calculated asper the clauses of STD document attached.21) All the terms in the tender include all lead lift, loading, unloading, transportation, labour, hire chares of machinery , curing for works. 22) Contractors should follow strictly prevailing rules of labour act. 23) The tender validity period is 90Days from last date of receipt of Tenders.24) The tenderer should submit the Registration Certificate along with technical bid.

25)The intending contractors are requested to note that they should abide by the detailed instructions and conditions contained in the Standard Bid document KW. 6) The contractor should maintain the work for the period of ONE year after the completion of the work at his own cost. 27)The Contractor shall furnish compulsory the value of existing commitments and ongoing works to be complete during the next 3 Months (B Value). 28)It is mandatory that the Turn over certificate should be duly signed by a registered Chartered Accountant along with UDIN number.29) The contractor should issued by the Commissioner, DAMH, Mysore regarding successfully completion of works which are taken in the previous years. (Mandatory).30) GST shall be paid separately to tendered amount.

31)Contractor during execution of the work as the responsibility of documentation including Hi-resolution photos before, during and after Completion of work and to be given three sets and Videos. 32) Contractor should be Installed A plaque depicting the entire history of the temple and information of the inscriptions translates the in to Kannada and English, Legal Information Board and a plaque containing the details of the work before starting the work as per the direction of the Higher authority.33)All safety precautions, warning signs, night illumination, reflectors, deployment of security guards has to be ensured so that no untoward incident happens on account of negligence or any project activity. Contractor should indemnify the client to that extent. 34)The work should be Completed Within 03 (three) Months (including Monsoon)
